title: Quản trị Tài chính trong du lịch và khách sạn

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basics of financial management, including financial statements, financial analysis, and financial decision-making in the hospitality industry.
Understand the basics of accounting, including financial statements and financial analysis.
Understand the basics of taxation, including the impact of taxes on businesses.
Apply financial decision-making principles to evaluate investment projects and manage short-term assets.
Understand the basics of project management, including investment decision-making.
Analyze business performance using financial statements and financial analysis.
Develop leadership skills through group projects and discussions.
Improve communication skills through class participation and group projects.
Develop critical thinking skills through financial analysis and decision-making.
Apply problem-solving skills to financial management issues.

prerequisite_courses: Lý thuyết tài chính tiền tệ
